title: Bound or document verbose check-ignore reply capacity relative to candidate input
outcome: The review identity ignore-query capacity contract accounts for verbose reply expansion and keeps the existing resource ceilings and fail-closed behavior.
acceptance: The per-level check-ignore query and verbose reply ceilings are documented consistently, or batches are bounded by a demonstrated safe reply budget without weakening limits or discovery completeness.
Focused regression coverage distinguishes a permitted candidate batch from an output-limit refusal, and full-gate/review evidence accompanies any implementation change.
